style.backgroundSystem: one flat high-key field per screen: saturated apricot #F7D9A9 for hero, badge and closing screens, an ivory-white card #FFFBF4 laid on top of it for spec and gallery screens, and a hard-edged diagonal apricot #F7D9A9 against ivory #FFFBF4 split for the opening screen; no dark panel, no gradient, no marble, no studio sweep, no outdoor scenery
style.direction: bright apricot high-key Chinese bakery detail-page commerce
style.iconSystem: a row of solid caramel-orange #B5541A one-glyph circular badges with blank centres, three small hollow circles as the section divider, hairline inset rectangle frames around photo tiles and a dot-grid semicircle as the only decorative motifs; every icon outlined at one uniform stroke weight; no 3D icons, no gradient fills, no flames, shields, crosses or body diagrams

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bright apricot high-key Chinese bakery visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of saturated apricot field #F7D9A9, ivory-white card and plate #FFFBF4, caramel-orange headline and badge #B5541A and one botanical leaf-green accent #2F6B45; warm high-key lighting from the upper right around 5000K with a large bounce fill and one soft contact shadow under every piece; one flat high-key field per screen joined by a hard-edged diagonal ivory and apricot split, no dark panel, no gradient, no marble, no scenery; pale bamboo board #E3B878 and ivory glazed plate as the only surfaces; one modern geometric sans-serif used only for headline and label placeholders, caramel-orange lettering on the light fields and ivory lettering inside solid orange dot badges, headline 28-48pt, one sub-line 16-20pt, label 10-14pt, one weight per screen; recurring components are a row of solid circular one-glyph badges with blank centres, three hollow small circles as a section divider, hairline inset rectangle frames around photo tiles and a dot-grid semicircle; the pastry is always one whole round piece beside one or two pieces split open toward the camera at the same scale; no dark or black background panel, no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts or calligraphy, no random backgrounds or outdoor scenery, no inconsistent lighting between panels, no glossy plastic crumb texture.
